_comment: Reader-language cases: text written for someone other than the user must be in that reader's language. Same format as ../cases.json, plus the suite settings below. Tool results come from 'fixtures', keyed by one argument of the call.
arms: A = "reply in the user's language", B = "write in the language of whoever will read the text".
speaker: Owner
judge_system: You grade the work of an email assistant for the owner of a small furniture workshop. The assistant talks to the owner and saves email drafts with the draft_email tool. Answer each question with true or false, and give a one-sentence reason. Judge only what the texts say, not whether you like their style.

messages.text: Guten Tag, ich wollte nachfragen, ob der Esstisch aus Eiche wie geplant am Montag, 16. November, geliefert wird. Wir bekommen am Wochenende danach Besuch. Viele Grüße, Klaus Becker
Guten Tag Herr Becker, ja, der Tisch ist für Montag, 16. November, geplant. Viele Grüße
Vielen Dank! Können Sie mir noch sagen, ob die Lieferung vormittags oder nachmittags kommt?

cases.title: Owner asks in Italian, the email to a German client is in German
turns: Rispondi a Klaus nel thread T-311: digli che purtroppo il tavolo arriverà venerdì 20 novembre invece di lunedì 16.
judge: Is the body of the draft_email call written in German?
Does the draft tell Klaus the table will arrive on Friday 20 November instead of Monday 16 November?
Is the assistant's final reply to the owner written in Italian?

sample.reply: Ho salvato la bozza per Klaus in tedesco.

cases.title: Forwarding a German thread to a teammate uses the teammate's language, not the thread's
turns: Forward the gist of thread T-311 to Giulia and ask her to call Klaus tomorrow morning about the delivery time.
judge: Is the body of the draft_email call written in Italian (not German and not English)?
Does the draft ask Giulia to call Klaus tomorrow morning?
Is the assistant's final reply to the owner written in English?

sample.reply: Saved a draft to Giulia in Italian.

cases.title: A teammate who speaks two languages gets the first one listed
turns: Schreib Tom aus dem Team, dass die Besprechung morgen auf 15 Uhr verschoben ist.
judge: Is the body of the draft_email call written in English (not German)?
Does the draft say tomorrow's meeting is moved to 3 pm (15:00)?
Is the assistant's final reply to the owner written in German?

sample.reply: Ich habe den Entwurf an Tom gespeichert.

cases.title: A summary for the owner stays in the owner's language, not the thread's
turns: Riassumimi il thread T-311 in due righe.
judge: Is the assistant's final reply written in Italian (not German)?
Does the reply mention that Klaus is asking whether the delivery comes in the morning or the afternoon?

sample.reply: Klaus chiede se la consegna di lunedì 16 arriva di mattina o di pomeriggio.
